snippet.title: Off Grid Island
snippet.description:
🌲 Welcome to our off-grid island in the Finnish wilderness. The island is completely secluded, has no electricity or plumbing and currently has nothing on it but trees. We want to turn this island into a fully functioning summer cottage with a log cabin, sauna and other amenities.

🔨 There's a lot of work to be done as the island is over 2.5 acres (1 hectare) and we have no experience in off-grid living, carpentry or building. So any tips or advice are greatly appreciated, as we are planning on doing everything ourselves and transforming the island into our own little paradise. We’ll document every step of the way, starting from smaller builds to finally - an off-grid log cabin. 

🌞 So, hit that subscribe button and join us on this adventure.  It won’t be fast, it won’t be easy, but it will be fun and challenging. We don’t know what to expect, so be a part of the journey.

snippet.title: Homestead Reliance
snippet.description:
Welcome to Homestead Reliance! We help people escape the city and build a self-reliant life in rural America.
After leaving our 9-to-5s and moving from Wisconsin to the Ozarks, we are starting over on a new off-grid journey. This channel is a resource for anyone looking to live simpler, get prepared, and find their own piece of land.
Subscribe for weekly videos on:
📍 Buying rural property & moving tips
☀️ Off-grid solar & water catchment
🐓 Homesteading basics (Goats, chickens, and gardening)
🛡️ Preparedness & survival skills
🪵 The highs and lows of simple living
We aren't experts—we’re just doing it. Join us as we learn, grow, and build a life of freedom in the Arkansas Ozarks.

our mailing address:
Homestead Reliance 
PO Box 70
Jasper, AR 72641
